trajectory_summary: The call opens confused and cold, builds mild rapport through tenure small talk and bill disclosure, then stalls when the rep goes on an unexplained hold and the bill document can't be captured live. It ends on a soft, unlocked promise rather than a booked or even clearly tentative appointment.
outcome_dispute: V1 tag is unknown; observed transcript shows no appointment date/time was ever proposed or agreed — the call ends on a bill-follow-up promise only, which should be read as no_appointment, not booked or tentative.
